The '''Pembric system''' was located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was an isolated system due to erratic radiation fields and the [[Pembric asteroid field]]. Because of this, the planet [[Pembric II]] was a haven for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and criminals.
